patterns.proposal: Show Today, a workout and a weekly review in store media. Lead with one coordinated day.
patterns.verification: Test whether five target users can explain the app's purpose from the first three screenshots.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Give a useful local starter day before optional account setup; disclose local-only backup limits.
patterns.verification: Reach a sample plan without health disclosure, payment or cloud account.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Use roughly 20 branching areas in groups; preview how each answer changes the plan; allow skip/resume.
patterns.verification: Edit available equipment or time and see only relevant suggestions change.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.benchmarks: Own requirement; no competitor clinical clearance established
patterns.proposal: Ask only necessary optional health questions; show missing units/constraints and withhold unsupported prescriptions.
patterns.verification: Unknown units never create calorie, load or deadline calculations.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: One global capture control; confirm parsed date, duration and goal in editable chips.
patterns.verification: Capture an ambiguous date and preserve the original text until confirmed.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.benchmarks: Cronometer recipe importer as a narrow analogy
patterns.proposal: Stage extracted facts with source page, timezone and confidence; dedupe and preview calendar changes.
patterns.verification: Import one academic event twice; create one event after explicit confirmation; undo restores state.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Compare available time and recovery with required effort; protect sleep/family blocks; explain tradeoffs.
patterns.verification: An overfull week produces scope/deadline choices and never hides an overlap.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Offer a brief review, three meaningful priorities and a plan adjustment, plus a fast skip path.
patterns.verification: Low-energy input proposes a smaller day without changing locked appointments.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Present one current session, the time until the next fixed commitment, then a compact timeline.
patterns.verification: Next action identified within five seconds; completed task reachable in at most two taps.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Show prerequisite → short practice → evidence/reflection → next session; resource details stay one tap away.
patterns.verification: A watched tutorial alone cannot complete a practical competence milestone.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Prior reps/load beside current entry; timer, cues, substitutions and 'short on time' action in session.
patterns.verification: No dumbbell recommendations with that equipment excluded; restart recovers completed sets.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Group skills by prerequisites/ability; repeat or regress when feedback warrants; retain history.
patterns.verification: A beginner profile sees feasible entry progressions and can report inability/discomfort.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Provide shadowboxing/footwork rounds with rest and technique resources; bag mode checks equipment.
patterns.verification: A home shadowboxing session works without sensors, bag or fabricated punch statistics.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.benchmarks: Own safety requirement; competitor skill-path analogy only
patterns.proposal: Schedule coach-led basing/spotting learning and approved home preparation; record confirmed milestones.
patterns.verification: An XP level or video completion cannot unlock an elevated lift plan.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Recent meals and portions first; optional photo/voice creates an editable draft with provenance.
patterns.verification: Change an ingredient/portion before saving and visibly recalculate estimates.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Separate meal timing from food choices; retain optional window tracking; show evidence/suitability.
patterns.verification: Longer fasting or eating less never awards more XP; users can change timing without penalty.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Convert selected meals into editable ingredients and preparation tasks on the shared calendar.
patterns.verification: Serving changes update grocery quantities; allergy substitutions require confirmation.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Use existing XP ledger and optional journey/cosmetics; show what action earned the award.
patterns.verification: Repeated check/sync cannot duplicate XP; undo reverses only the corresponding award.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.step: Missed task, illness or low-energy day
patterns.proposal: Use a return screen with keep, shrink, reschedule or drop choices; protect recovery.
patterns.verification: A missed day creates no shame/debt; no automatic overload tomorrow.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Show measured trends and skill/workout progress separately from XP; inspect assumptions and uncertainty.
patterns.verification: No single weigh-in creates an exact arrival date; missing data lowers confidence.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Review capacity, actual duration, performance and recovery together; preview proposed changes.
patterns.verification: User can accept individual revisions while locked commitments remain fixed.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Ask what was in the user's control and one adjustment for tomorrow; link verified quote or labeled original reflection.
patterns.verification: Saved reflection persists; generated text can never acquire a historical attribution automatically.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Explain permission state, quiet hours, alarm versus reminder, and a test-delivery action.
patterns.verification: Verify real devices closed/locked/offline/reboot; record missed-delivery limits.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Private defaults, local core, optional sync consent, per-item sharing and recoverable drafts.
patterns.verification: Offline logging/restart/reconnect preserves data and XP exactly once.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Show actual charge/renewal, inclusions, restore and cancellation help; preserve historical records and export.
patterns.verification: Cancel an approved test entitlement without loss of user data; restore/export round-trip verified.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented

patterns.proposal: Measure time-to-value, task success and voluntary useful return; collect optional feedback without health payloads.
patterns.verification: A 14-day pilot reports failures and usefulness; no invented retention target or causal uplift.
patterns.status: Proposed for phase review; not implemented
